date_basis: date_checked is UTC. source_date identifies the publication, revision, or dated state reported by the source.

trust_levels.public_run_record: A primary public run report, CI result or log was inspected. The verdict belongs to its operator and only to the target described.
trust_levels.primary_text: Primary text or source metadata was inspected. Its mathematical or computational assertions retain the author's evidence level.

reproductions.author: Levent Alpöge
reproductions.verified_evidence: Author note pp. 1 and 4 announces RH and Dirichlet GRH and describes theta-lift iteration. Fetched PDF matches the existing source lock.
reproductions.limitations: The chronology provides no quantitative proof of the lift estimate.
reproductions.potential_use: Identify the exact cost lemma in Lean.

reproductions.author: Andrew Sutherland (MIT)
reproductions.verified_evidence: Report gives 175,187/175,187 source modules built and replayed. audit.log lists only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound for each of five named targets. nanoda.log records exit 0 on the full solution export as identified by the report.
reproductions.limitations: Unsandboxed direct Lean build. Default and paranoid export checks and full Comparator still running at the report timestamp. This pass inspected the report and two small logs.
reproductions.potential_use: Baseline for a sandboxed export comparison and a separate semantic audit.

reproductions.author: Deicyde
reproductions.verified_evidence: GitHub run 44813916558 reports success for archive identity and the Mathlib-only challenge build/export. The pinned Results section still reports the solution build in progress.
reproductions.limitations: CI omits the full solution. The smoke-test verdict refers to four other theorems. MIT's use of the same challenge limits independence of target selection.
reproductions.potential_use: Compare independently produced challenge and solution digests separately.

reproductions.author: Amahane-Hikari
reproductions.verified_evidence: M109806 receipt and matching target name in the build log document exit 0 for the module ending in ExplicitConstants.UniformIffAboveThreshold.
reproductions.limitations: One Lake target. The 8706 jobs include dependencies. Binaries and input manifest were not checked here.
reproductions.potential_use: Template for a receipt for a single extracted lemma.

reproductions.author: CocoSgt
reproductions.verified_evidence: README describes an unmodified archive import. Main and Statements at import commit 0fb9869c6e6d7b54b67de803af0e0be29d37fc22 matched the corresponding Deicyde files by SHA-256.
reproductions.limitations: Our byte comparison covers two files. The mirror offers no independent replay receipt.
reproductions.potential_use: Pin the exact declarations for statement and dependency inspection.

reproductions.author: SINF-KEN
reproductions.verified_evidence: GitHub identifies Deicyde/riemann-hypothesis as parent. Fork README displays the upstream CI badge and a running Comparator status.
reproductions.limitations: Inherited upstream status supplies no separate operator verdict.
reproductions.potential_use: Avoid double-counting an earlier fork snapshot.

reproductions.author: Tomodovodoo
reproductions.verified_evidence: README describes a mirror and explicitly says it contains no build or kernel-check results.
reproductions.limitations: GitHub's non-fork flag is repository genealogy, not independent verification.
reproductions.potential_use: Locate the source entry point and credit the original author.

reproductions.author: TomasOrtega
reproductions.verified_evidence: README identifies extracted/lean/ as the project extracted from the announcement archive.
reproductions.limitations: No independent check log identified in the inspected README.

reproductions.author: Timothy Chow (community-wiki answer)
reproductions.verified_evidence: Answer 518036 attributes an outline to Fable via Chris Birkbeck, proposes identifying unfamiliar ingredients, and links O’Desky’s catalogue.
reproductions.limitations: Interpretation and research leads. The outline has no local declaration-level verification here.
reproductions.potential_use: Guide a bounded search for one novel step.

reproductions.author: Andrew O’Desky
reproductions.verified_evidence: Catalogue displayed 60 restatements, 17 tagged checked against Lean, and a partial compile. HTML SHA-256 e00630f61bd16c7608dad60eef4863458c1a21f68cceedb30a807f1dafab83ad.
reproductions.limitations: Catalogue labels are the investigator’s. A checked restatement is narrower than a checked mathematical proof.
reproductions.potential_use: Look up a specific theta-scalar or prime-sum declaration for later reading.

reproductions.author: Levent Alpöge and Ralph Furman
reproductions.verified_evidence: Theorems A/B in v2 state partial asymptotic proportions for zeta and each fixed primitive character. Lemmas 3.1/3.2 give inertia under pullback and a finite Hermitian rank–trace inequality.
reproductions.limitations: August result. No independent replay of its Lean code or audit of its analytic estimates in this pass.
reproductions.potential_use: Test a finite compression with indefinite off-line pair blocks.

reproductions.author: Alessandro Maria Masullo
reproductions.verified_evidence: PDF SHA-256 matches the repository source lock. Physical pp. 35, 519–520 and 522 inspected. Theorem 13.3.1.2 has a title and an insertion footnote without a statement.
reproductions.limitations: Selected pages only. Theorem 12.5.1.1 and the proposed terminal deduction were not verified.
reproductions.potential_use: Audit the cutoff and strip parameters and the test-function restriction.

reproductions.author: Ravi Vakil
reproductions.verified_evidence: Vakil reports months of review and extensive feedback from Brian Conrad and requests public checking of the draft.
reproductions.limitations: The post is primary evidence of Vakil’s announcement. It supplies no public completed report from Conrad.
reproductions.potential_use: Track dated manuscript revisions and public critiques.

reproductions.author: Nomen, comment on Terence Tao’s blog
reproductions.verified_evidence: Comment 699604 identifies editorial placeholders and labels a linked AI audit preliminary. Physical p. 522 independently confirms a missing terminal statement.
reproductions.limitations: The AI discussion was not used as evidence. Incompleteness of a draft does not settle the underlying argument.
reproductions.potential_use: Recheck specific manuscript defects against a new version.

reproductions.author: Dave Goldblatt
reproductions.verified_evidence: Run B log names the seven-eighths zeta theorem and records nanoda and Lean default kernel acceptance for a separately written challenge.
reproductions.limitations: Methodology for another proof. The report identifies one operator and trust in the upstream configuration and patched dependencies.
reproductions.potential_use: Specify an independent challenge and include a per-kernel log.

reproductions.author: vstaln/riemann
reproductions.verified_evidence: README retires a claimed August improvement after the verifier used a different functional from the theorem and describes exact mass constraints in its revised work.
reproductions.limitations: Reported by the project. Neither the retirement analysis nor its replacement numerical floor was independently rerun here.
reproductions.potential_use: Test theorem-to-certificate identity and coefficient constraints.

reproductions.author: DrMurphyIsIn
reproductions.verified_evidence: README describes de Bruijn–Newman bounds, finite-window positivity and a conditional Riemann–Roch-square construction. It explicitly leaves RH open.
reproductions.limitations: Authors’ classification and reported checks. No build or independent receipt for those claims inspected here.
reproductions.potential_use: Preserve exact residual construction requirements in a conditional criterion.

reproductions.author: Youness Lamzouri
reproductions.verified_evidence: Lamzouri presents a shorter independent proof of the August Alpöge–Furman lower bound (>67.25% simple critical-line zeros), replacing its finite-dimensional Hermitian matrix method by a Hilbert-space inequality and unconditional pair correlation.
reproductions.limitations: A different proof of the August partial proportion theorem, not a verification or simplification of the November full GRH claim. This project's mathematical audit of Lamzouri's complete paper remains pending.
reproductions.potential_use: Compare the August finite-matrix argument and its Hilbert-space simplification; test whether an actual November sublemma admits an analogous reduction without transferring unproved hypotheses.

reproductions.author: Biao Wang
reproductions.verified_evidence: The author extends the Lamzouri-style conjugation-invariant finite-multiset inequality and unconditional pair-correlation estimates to proportion bounds for simple critical zeros in short intervals.
reproductions.limitations: Independent research on the earlier August 2026 partial result; it does not prove GRH and is not an independent check of the November Lean archive. Full paper and numerical constants not audited by this project.
reproductions.potential_use: Test stability and localization of simplification inequalities under restricted height windows; watch where uniform error terms enter.
